scripts.dev: fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null; concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c cyan,green "bun run --filter @lume/web dev" "bun run --filter @lume/desktop dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @lume/shared build && bun run --filter @lume/ui build && bun run --filter @lume/sidecar build && bun run --filter @lume/web build && bun run --filter @lume/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @lume/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @lume/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @lume/sidecar typecheck && bun run --filter @lume/web typecheck
